verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a Reports API that exposes the same analytics engine behind the dashboard's Reports section, so analytics can be retrieved programmatically. The evidence never says which metrics it covers, so it is unproven whether it reports product adoption or usage across a workspace rather than, say, support or feedback metrics. Missing for 10: documented usage or adoption metrics, workspace-level breakdowns, endpoint and metric detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can retrieve usage analytics to understand how the product is adopted across my workspace

citations.quote: The Reports API exposes the same analytics engine that powers the Reports section of the Featurebase dashboard.
